install: NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-/opt/nvm}"; if [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm install 24; nvm alias default 24 >/dev/null; NODE_PREFIX="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(nvm which 24)")")"; if [ -w "$NVM_DIR" ]; then ln -sfn "$NODE_PREFIX" "$NVM_DIR/current"; NODE_BIN="$NVM_DIR/current/bin"; else NODE_BIN="$NODE_PREFIX/bin"; fi; export PATH="$NODE_BIN:$PATH"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF "export PATH=\"$NODE_BIN:\$PATH\"" "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo "export PATH=\"$NODE_BIN:\$PATH\"" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; fi; if [ -x /usr/bin/google-chrome ]; then sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PW_CHROMIUM_PATH="/usr/bin/google-chrome"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PW_CHROMIUM_PATH="/usr/bin/google-chrome"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; fi; npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
